[[Korsin]] '''Vandoz''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] man and one of the commanders of the [[Korsinite League]]. In [[3000 BBY]] he went to [[Tahv]] to take part to the [[Testament Day]], and to stop the plan of the [[Sisters of Seelah]].
